transform_log: 1. Select: heuristically picked 3 raw clips (56.mp4, 50.mp4, 39.mp4) out of the untagged raw pool by weakest available proxy (smallest file sizes among the 58 available clips, on the theory that lower-motion/lower-detail footage is more likely to be static, dim, low-key material matching the requested dim/dark gym visual_direction). This was NOT a real content review — there is no video-viewing capability available in this pipeline step, so visual match to 'dim/dark gym interior, pre-dawn lighting, solitary figure' is unverified and should be treated as approximate/unconfirmed, not confirmed.
2. Reframe/crop: applied crop='min(iw,ih*9/16)':'min(ih,iw*16/9)' then scale=1080:1920 to each of the 3 source clips (source was 1920x1080 landscape) to reframe to vertical 1080x1920.
3. Speed/color change: applied both — setpts=PTS/0.90 (10% slow-down) on the concatenated sequence, and eq=contrast=1.10:saturation=1.12:brightness=0.0 color grade on each clip.

4. Burn in on-screen text: chained 5 separate drawtext filters (one per non-empty on_screen_text beat from the script) using enable='between(t,start,end)' timed to match the script's beat boundaries (3-7s, 7-12s, 12-18s, 18-24s, 24-29s); text content pulled verbatim from sf_001.on_screen_text. The 0:00-0:03 beat has empty text in the script so no drawtext was applied there.

5. Replace audio: original clip audio was never mapped/included in the output (filter graph only maps [vout] and the new [a] audio stream) — full audio replaced with the verified CC0 track 'Phonk ish' by HoliznaCC0 from state/cc0_audio_library.json, trimmed to 29s with a 2s fade-out at the end.

6. Voiceover: NOT added. The script's voiceover_script.full_text/beats were not synthesized or recorded in this pass — no TTS engine was available/invoked in this step. This is a gap versus the full script brief; the output currently relies on burned-in text only to carry the line content, with no spoken narration.

7. Duration: exported at 29s, within the 15-45s target range (~28-30s as instructed). Source material was only ~4-10s per clip, so the 3-clip sequence (total ~15.9s raw) was played twice back-to-back (concat n=6, sequence ABCABC) then slowed 10% and trimmed to 29s to reach target duration -- this repetition is a real editorial compromise, not a full continuous 29s of unique footage.

voiceover_script.full_text: 3am. No alarm going off. No one clapping. No one watching. Motivation left the moment it got hard — it always does. It's a feeling, and feelings don't show up on schedule. Discipline isn't loud. It isn't a mood. It's the decision you already made, so you don't have to make it again tonight. You're not here because you feel like it. You're here because you built a system that doesn't ask how you feel. Nobody's coming to save you. Get up. Again.
